product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Industrial Hexagonal Planter, 9.06"H, Gold
product.description: This beautiful, industrial-style metal planter comes in a gold tone. A hexagonal shape brings visual interest to this piece that is sure to draw some attention. The size makes it a great choice for use on a table or other flat surface. 9.45"D x 8.27"W x 9.06"H 100% iron This metal planter is made of 100% iron and comes in a gold tone. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
